title: Revocation of Irrevocable Deeds of Gift on the Ground of Gross Ingratitude Act
long_title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR REVOCATION OF IRREVOCABLE DEEDS OF GIFT ON THE GROUND OF GROSS INGRATITUDE AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH AND INCIDENTAL THERETO.
enacting_formula: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

body.heading: Revocation of an irrevocable deed of gift by a competent court.
body.raw_text: 2. An irrevocable deed of gift may be revoked on the ground of gross ingratitude, only on an Order made by a competent court, in an action filed by the donor of such deed against the donee to have the said deed revoked.

source_location.note: PDF page 2 (printed page 1) carries the long title, the enacting formula and sections 1 to 4(1)(b); PDF page 3 (printed page 2) carries section 4(2) to section 7; PDF page 4 (printed page 3) carries only the Publications Bureau subscription imprint.

verification_note: All seven sections, both definitions and every heading were transcribed and read word for word against the Government Printer print (pdftotext -layout, poppler) and compared against the paralegal.lk consolidated text held at statutes/HTML/Revocation Of Irrevocable Deeds Of Gift On The Ground Of Gross Ingratitude Act.txt, which agrees on every word (it renders the em dash as a hyphen and the curly quotes as straight quotes). Structural only; legal effect is not verified.

provenance.against: Government Printer PDF pages 2 and 3 rendered with pdftotext -layout under PowerShell (poppler); second reading against the paralegal.lk text
provenance.what_changed: scripts/parse_consolidated_pdf.py --source-id SRC037 --edition as_enacted split the single-column Government Printer page at the wrong column, so every marginal note landed inside the operative text (section 1 read 'the Revocation of Short title. Irrevocable Deeds'), sections 2 and 3 lost half their words to the heading field, section 4(2) was folded into paragraph 4(1)(b) together with the running header and the printer's job number, the definition of 'Land' was appended to the definition of 'Registrar of Lands', and section 7 swallowed the page-3 imprint. Every section, subsection, paragraph and definition was re-transcribed from the print; the parser's reading is kept per section under parser_reading. Headings restored to the printed marginal notes. Cross-references rebuilt: the two phantom 'Gross Ingratitude Act' enactment references were dropped and the references to section 2, subsection 4(1), the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117) and the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101) added. Publisher, certification date, Gazette date and Legal Draftsman number read from the cover and page 1.
